author: Justin Hawkins Rides Again
description:
🎟️ To come and see Justin Hawkins Rides Again LIVE across the UK in January and February, find tickets here: 
https://www.aegpresents.co.uk/event/justin-hawkins-rides-again/
🎟️ For VIP upgrades: https://thejawsofvictory.com/pages/justin-hawkins-rides-again?srsltid=AfmBOorryy6x7BKwj8HeKF7R1Jdtat6hl3fNPuhRJfMpQWxpCC2o1IqT

Today I'm talking about another artist I'm meeting on the road: Mark Daly. Mark supported my band, The Darkness recently so I wanted to introduce you to him. His new single, In The Dark, is out today but to find out more about him, visit:  https://hypeddit.com/markdaly/inthedark 
and https://www.youtube.com/@MarkDalyMusic 

To go behind the scenes and to find out more about me, become one of my esteemed Patrons here: http://www.patreon.com/jushawk

For Cameo messages: https://www.cameo.com/justinhawkins

The Darkness are touring Australia next month: https://www.thedarknesslive.com/tour-dates/

Get a Justin Hawkins Rides Again T-Shirt & Hoodie here: https://thejawsofv
